short_description: Non-canonical FirstPersonEmbodiment prototype layered on the accepted CH9.6 character, clothing, Item Graph and ENet presentation stack.
purpose: Evaluate first-person hands, clothing-visible viewmodels, independent left/right grip UX and network-state projection without reopening or mutating the frozen CH9.6 checkpoint and without claiming item/network authority.
expected_outcome: A separate research lab can render two first-person hands, mirror the server-backed selected hotbar item, project upper clothing into first person, exercise local-only grab targets, and fail closed for canonical world-item grabbing until an explicit hand authority contract is authorized.
current_stage: FPE-R1 Fix4 — nonblocking authoritative hotbar selection
progress_note: Fix3 succeeded on the Windows Godot 4.7.1 stable double a13da4feb operator checkout. Godot class-cache preflight passed; the core FirstPersonEmbodiment contract passed 23 assertions; the exact graphical scene-load gate passed 5 assertions; PLAY launched successfully; first/third person switching rendered the procedural FPE hands; and Q/E local sandbox interaction worked. The operator then observed severe runtime hitches while selecting hotbar slots / interacting with inventory plus M4_ITEM_COMMAND_TIMEOUT and M4_ITEM_COMMAND_SEND_FAILED. Code review isolated the hotbar hitch: ItemGameplayController.select_hotbar routes replica mode to the M7 bridge; inventory.select_hotbar is not in the NX6 predictable-command set, so M7 falls through to _submit_blocking and waits for COMMAND_RESULT on the main thread. In the single-process CH9.6 graphical lab this can starve the local client/server process loop until timeout. Fix4 leaves accepted M7/CH9 authority code untouched and adds an FPE-owned FirstPersonHotbarNetworkAdapter. It sends inventory.select_hotbar directly as RELIABLE_ORDERED ITEM_COMMAND without waiting, applies only an immediate local presentation index, and confirms or rolls back that presentation from the canonical server Item Graph snapshot. A focused adapter test passed synthetically on Godot 4.7.1 double with 15 assertions and verifies blocking_waits=0. The FPE HUD was also moved away from inherited CH6-CH9 diagnostics to reduce overlap. Missing Male_Peasant.gltf remains a separate nonfatal external-asset condition and is not the hotbar hitch root cause.
